The '''Line/Flank Formation''' was the most commonly used [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] formation. The formation was comprised of groups of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] or [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] traveling in either vertical or horizontal lines. Although they were often single file formations, double file formations were used on occasion. The formation was used by groups of walkers that had to quickly traverse open ground before engaging the enemy and shifting into other attack patterns.
